summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundle unrelated to package purpose
details: @or-sdk/graph@1.10.7 declares a preinstall script (node setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ and then uses execFileSync to run a bundled sibling file math_init.js under Bun on npm install. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle with heavy string-array obfuscation (a rotating dictionary via a WV8StW-style shift function, hex-obfuscated identifiers, and large encoded literal tables); no code in the published TypeScript sources produces this file and no build step in the repository generates it. The package advertises itself as a small Neo4j/Cypher graph SDK, which has no need for a Bun runtime or a Bun-compiled native bundle; math_init.js is not documented in the README or referenced from the TypeScript sources. The setup.mjs loader itself also uses obfuscator.io-style names. Installing the package therefore runs opaque, obfuscated code with no source correspondence under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime that bypasses Node-based scanners, on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
